answer: Proof of space-time mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit dedicated storage to periodic audits. Instead of letting a river of synthetic identities overwhelm consensus, nodes must prove retained disk sectors. An attacker incurs verifiable hardware costs to provision physical drives per identity, driving clone profitability to a nadir. A key limitation is that industrial storage pools leverage economies of scale, easily marginalizing an honest node as small as a sparrow.
